description: This file defines a data class 'Recipe' that models a recipe object for the Android TV frontend application, implementing Parcelable for inter-component data transfer.

classes.name: Recipe
classes.description: A data class representing a recipe with properties such as id, title, description, imageUrl, videoUrl, and category, designed for use in Android Parcelable communications.

methods.name: Recipe constructor
methods.description: Primary constructor for initializing a Recipe instance with id, title, description, imageUrl, optional videoUrl, and category.
